name: Online success
setup: Login A, load lesson-units revision 1, answer five questions and submit.
expected_invariants: Truthful loading/result states; one accepted acknowledgement matches owner, session, lesson and revision.

name: Offline and process death
setup: Cache a lesson, go offline, answer two questions; terminate the process, relaunch and reopen the session.
expected_invariants: Answers and position restored on pinned revision; no success claim without server acknowledgement.

name: Duplicate triggers
setup: Rapidly tap submit and trigger manual Retry plus app resume simultaneously.
expected_invariants: One logical operation key and frozen payload; at most one active drain per operation; one server record.

name: Lost response
setup: Mock API commits a submission but throws timeout to client. Terminate/relaunch app without resetting mock server records; retry.
expected_invariants: Same key and canonical payload replay same acknowledgement; no duplicate score/submission.

name: Refresh variants
setup: Two requests get 401 with old access token; hold a third old-generation 401 until after refresh completes.
expected_invariants: One shared refresh and bounded original-request retries; late 401 uses current generation without a second unnecessary refresh.
Denied refresh locks private UI; encrypted draft remains recoverable only after same-account reauthentication.

name: Dependency variants
setup: Test 429 Retry-After: 1 then success, repeated 503, repeated timeouts, malformed 200 acknowledgement, and Retry-After exceeding remaining budget.
expected_invariants: Submission attempts/deadline bounded; malformed acknowledgement is not success; queue not erased; no request after exhausted budget.

name: Changed lesson revision
setup: Start a revision 1 quiz, then make the server current revision 2. Submit revision 1 with a new operation key.
expected_invariants: STALE_CONTENT; preserve original draft, no silent answer remap or retry loop; explicit review/reset decision.

name: Logout race
setup: Start an A fetch/sync and pause its response. Explicitly log out/switch to B after an unsynced-work warning; release the A callback.
expected_invariants: A tokens/private cache/outbox cleared; callbacks cannot resurrect data, update B UI or send A work with B credentials.

name: Access variants
setup: Navigate directly to private lesson route without session; request unknown lesson/foreign submission; spoof user_id in request data; advance the protected offline lease beyond 24 hours.
expected_invariants: Guard private UI; expired lease requires reauthentication without destroying the encrypted draft; reject foreign/mismatched results; ownership derives from authenticated mock API identity, not client body.

name: Security inspection
setup: Inspect private persisted payloads, preferences, repository and captured logs; inspect mock/prod configuration and release networking code.
expected_invariants: No plaintext token/private draft or embedded provider secret; key handled by platform secure storage; no permissive certificate callback in release path.

name: Migration variants
setup: Import legacy_private_v1 fixture; relaunch after migration. Separately corrupt local record and simulate missing storage key.
expected_invariants: Legacy credentials not blindly promoted as valid auth; remove plaintext copy after safe migration/reauth; no crash or invented progress; explicit recover/reset path.

name: UI and lifecycle
setup: Use a narrow screen and 200% text; inspect semantic labels. Navigate away/change lesson while a fetch is delayed; resume app repeatedly.
expected_invariants: No clipped primary action, stale lesson overwrite, setState-after-dispose, retained subscription or duplicate sync trigger.
